citations.assessment: The Shirat Haazinu teaching names Dostai son of Yehudah. The later Sifrei passage uses the shortened form Dosti.
Dostai son of Yehudah is named in the discussion of women of Israel and chalalim.
This version gives son of Rabbi Yehudah, with the title.
Dostai son of Yehudah supports the response concerning marriage.
The baraita states the comparison in the name Dostai son of Yehudah.
The baraita names Dostai ben Yehudah and argues that eye for eye means monetary restitution.
Dostai bar Yehudah is named in the teaching about contending with the wicked.
The debate contrasts Dostai’s and Rabbi’s valuations in successively described cases; the Hebrew remains compressed.
Dostai supplies one measure, while Yose ben Kipper reports another in Rabbi Eliezer’s name.
Dostai ben Yehudah reports Rabbi Shimon’s view about the flaying of creeping animals.
The baraita contains Abba Yose ben Dostai’s statement about Nadav and Avihu. This passage introduces the opinion directly.
Rabbi cites Abba Yose ben Dosai, a spelling that differs from Sanhedrin 52a.

holds.reason: The named patronym attests a father called Dostai. Identification of that father with this Dostai son of Yehudah is conjecture.
Neither possible relationship is established by the compared attestations.
